chunks: (That) We sent it down one night of blessing -- so that We could warn --

key_terms.أَنْزَلْنَاهُ: We sent it down (referring to the Quran)

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the night when the Quran was sent down?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this verse is often linked to Laylat al-Qadr, the night of the Quran's initial descent to the lowest heaven, marking the beginning of the prophetic mission. The term 'Mubarakah' (blessed) underscores the divine wisdom and mercy inherent in this revelation, serving as a pivotal moment for guidance and warning to all of humanity.
